sleek-saas.label: Sleek SaaS
sleek-saas.summary: Crisp, calm and focused. Side navigation, generous whitespace.

mobile-social.label: Mobile-first social
mobile-social.summary: Thumb-friendly and lively. Bottom navigation, rounded cards.

editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.summary: Reading-first with serif headings, quiet chrome and strong type.

playful.label: Playful
playful.summary: Bright, friendly and bouncy. Big buttons and cheerful colour.

data-console.label: Data console
data-console.summary: Dense and information-rich. Dark by default, built for scanning.

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.summary: Browse-and-buy friendly. Search up top, image-led listings.

accounts.label: Accounts and sign-in
accounts.summary: People can create an account and sign in.

profiles.label: User profiles
profiles.summary: Each person has a profile page others can see.

dashboard.label: Dashboard
dashboard.summary: A home screen summarising what matters right now.

search.label: Search
search.summary: Find things quickly across the app.

messaging.label: Messages and comments
messaging.summary: People can talk to each other or comment on things.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.summary: Tell people when something needs their attention.

content.label: Content pages
content.summary: Publish articles, posts or informational pages.

uploads.label: File and photo uploads
uploads.summary: People can upload images or files.

admin.label: Admin area
admin.summary: A private area for running the app.
